description: This file defines the class FormatWithEmptyString which implements the ValueFormatter interface. Its purpose is to provide a formatting strategy that always returns an empty string regardless of the input value.

classes.name: FormatWithEmptyString
classes.description: A class implementing the ValueFormatter interface to format values by returning an empty string.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns an empty string, ignoring the input parameter.
